verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM is a SaaS CRM with built-in AI (Zia, agents, MCP), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that excludes customer data from AI model training. The Zia and MCP items describe AI features, not data-use controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
